Diablo 4 Paladin Build (Arbiter of Justice) Falling Star Arbiter Build Lord of Hatred Guide
In this Diablo 4 build guide, I'm going to be showing you my Falling Star Paladin build for Diablo 4. This is more of an endgame focused build that revolves around using the Arbiter Form of Paladin, and it is absolutely decimating, it has very good clear speed. It's a ton of fun to play, but it's one that's very difficult to put together early on.
